claims: The NASA Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to the moon since 1972.
The NASA Artemis II mission launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The NASA Artemis II mission launched at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The NASA Artemis II mission launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The NASA Artemis II mission carried four astronauts.
The NASA Artemis II mission is a 10-day trip around the Moon.
Artemis II is a Crewed Test Flight.
The Artemis II launch site is Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The rocket for Artemis II is Space Launch System (SLS).
The Artemis II crew is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
